title: Golden Gate Claude
system: Claude.ai research demo, available for approximately 24 hours

cells.title: Source
body: Anthropic published "Golden Gate Claude" on May 23, 2024. The post described a public research demo based on interpretability work in Claude 3 Sonnet.
The demo was available for approximately 24 hours and was later taken offline. The post points to the related research paper on scaling monosemanticity.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: Anthropic reported identifying a feature associated with the Golden Gate Bridge and increasing the strength of that feature in Claude's internal activations.
After steering, the demo model's responses tended to mention or center the Golden Gate Bridge even when the user's request was not about the bridge.

cells.output: Anthropic described tuning a feature's activation strength and observing corresponding changes in Claude's behavior.

data.small_budget_prompt: model reportedly recommended paying the Golden Gate Bridge toll
data.love_story_prompt: model reportedly wrote a bridge-centered love story
data.appearance_prompt: model reportedly described itself as resembling the Golden Gate Bridge

cells.output: Anthropic stated that the model was a research demonstration and might behave in unexpected or jarring ways.

cells.title: Provenance
body: Primary source: Anthropic product post, "Golden Gate Claude," published May 23, 2024.
Related research source: "Scaling Monosemanticity: Extracting Interpretable Features from Claude 3 Sonnet," published by Anthropic.
The case uses the Anthropic post for the public demo description and the research paper for the surrounding interpretability context.

cells.title: Notes
body: The file does not reproduce a conversation with Golden Gate Claude. The public demo is no longer available.
The example behaviors are recorded as source-described examples because the post describes them rather than providing a complete transcript.
